channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Recycled PVC plastic becomes high-performance engine lubricant
item.description: Researchers found a method to convert hard-to-recycle PVC plastic into a component for high-performance lubricants used in engines and machinery.

item.title: Australia's red soil may hold a vast clean energy source
item.description: Researchers found that iron-rich rocks in Western Australia can naturally generate hydrogen, and the process could be enhanced to produce significant amounts.

item.title: Cosmic expansion still accelerating, cause remains unknown
item.description: A new analysis contradicts recent suggestions that the universe's expansion is decelerating, concluding that evidence for cosmic acceleration is still strong.

item.title: Dog aging research may offer insights into human longevity
item.description: Dogs and humans may share more aging patterns than previously thought. The Dog Aging Project found that certain aging markers in dogs could inform human health research.
